reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：番剧、国创与影视 → 排期、追番与评分 → 版权许可与观看权益 → 课程与学习进度。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Anime, Guochuang and Film → Schedule, Follows and Ratings → Copyright License and Entitlement → Courses and Learning Progress. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
